turns.assistant:

Additionally, real-world factors like temperature changes, saltwater corrosion, or physical impacts weaken these seals faster than in a perfect test environment. The time limit ensures the device remains safe within those specific parameters. Exceeding the duration or depth risks water ingress, which can permanently damage internal components.
